full_judgment: 2. The case of the petitioner, in brief, is that the land measuring 1.31 square yards situated in the District of Dhaka, Police Station Old Tejgaon, now Mirpur, Plot No. 17, Road No. 2, Block No. E, section 1 was allotted to Mr MA Salam, son of Dr Md Asadullah by a registered deed Of Settlement No. 4811 dated 23-5-1962 for 99 years by the then Government of East Pakistan with permission to construct houses thereon. The said allottee took possession of the land and constructed houses thereon and lived there and paid the entire premium of the lease to the Government. Thereafter, the said allottee was in need of money and contracted to sell the above land to the petitioner on 14-2-1971 and executed an agreement for sale in favour of the petitioner after taking Taka 12,000 as earnest money out of the total consideration of Taka 15,000 and delivered possession of the premises to the petitioner but did not execute and register a sale deed after taking the balance consideration money though the petitioner was in possession of the house. The petitioner ultimately brought Title Suit No. 9 of 1985 in the First Court of Munsif, Dhaka for a decree for specific performance of contract. The suit was decreed ex parte by judgment dated 19-4-1985. The petitioner then got the kabala executed and registered through court in his favour but unfortunately, the property was wrongly enlisted as abandoned property. The petitioner then filed an application before the Court of Settlement being Case No. 955 of 1987 for release of the property from the list of abandoned building. But the Court of Settlement by the impugned order dated 31-8-1988 dismissed the case for default as the petitioner failed to take any step.
